For fixed C: C ∉ F (minimality of C ∪ {p} ∈ H; need C ∪ {p} minimal implies C ∉ F — yes by inclusion-minimality, proper subset C not in F). By (2) (self-blocking), there is F_C ∈ F with F_C ∩ C = ∅.
